summary: Public demo repository containing a complete, real walkthrough of the runx local quickstart: npm install of @runxhq/cli 0.9.1, running examples/hello-world with both input forms, RUNX_RECEIPT_DIR behavior across skill/history/verify, receipt inspection via runx history --detail --json, and cryptographic verification via runx verify --allow-local-development-signatures. The actual sealed runx.receipt.v1 receipt is committed to the repo as sealed-receipt.json.
audience: developers evaluating governed runtimes for agent skills; newcomers who want to see exactly what the sealed-receipt flow produces before installing
venue_rule: A personal public GitHub repository is the operator's own demo artifact, explicitly listed by the bounty as an acceptable action type ('a relevant repo/demo/README/example that mentions runx'). No community rules are implicated.
